Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF UNSKILLED/ SKILLED STAFF (SAFAIWALA- 02, AND COOK- 04) FOR SERVICES TO DSC PLATOON AT COAST GUARD DISTRICT HEADQUARTERS NO.11 AND SCHEDULE OF DUTIES 1. Duties and Responsibility of outsourcing services. Safaiwala:- (a) The Outsourcing staff Safaiwala will be responsible for overall clean ing of area/offices of DSC OTM at DHQ-11(Goa) in their respective work pl ace as assigned. (b) Cleaning of administrative areas, Washroom, Toilet and relevant po rtion. (c) Housekeeping of all floors, rooms toilets mess office, TV room, dinin g hall, etc of the entire DSC blinding. (d) Each room to be fixed with Housekeeping check list. Entry is to be made by the Safaiwala. Cook:- (a) Preparing and serving foods for JCO, OF and Quartermaster. (b) Preparing and serving snacks and beverages as requirement. (c) Collection and Upkeep of provisions for Galley. (d) Preparing and parking of packet provisions during out station deplo yment of DSC staff.

(e) Maintaining Mess traps, Dry and Fresh provisions. (f) Providing Services during ceremonial function, official meeting /get -together and visits by dignitaries. (g) Coordinate purchase /utilization of available ration. (h) Prepare food as per decided menu at scheduled time and quantity. (j) Ensure kitchen and store hygiene. 2. Bid Additional Terms And Conditions (a) AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMEN TARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. (b) Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidatio n court receivership or similar proceedings should not be bankrupt. Bi dder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. (c) Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigen dum if any. (d) Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor code Creation: (i) Copy of PAN Card. (ii) Copy of GSTIN. (iii) Copy of Cancelled cheque. (iv) Copy of EFT Mandate duly certificate by Bank. (e) The Service Provider required to have at least 80% of the required manpower on service provider's payroll for at least one year. Necessary d ocuments relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for v erification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against t his bid.

(f) Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consigne e with GSTIN of Consignee only. (g) Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before qu oting. Buyerwill not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimburse ment will be as per actual or as applicable rates (whichever is lower), subj ect to the maximum of quoted GST %. (h) The ESI and PF shall be deposited by the Contractor well in time. (j) The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obt aining the prior written consent of buyer. (k) The s Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to a ny entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. (l) The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-cont ract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee / sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performa nce of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. (m) The service provider/bidder (individual / firm / company) should not b e black listed / prosecuted by any Central / State Governments / Union Te rritories/Departments/Offices/StatutoryBodies/Autonomous. Organizations / Research Institutions/any court of law. The bidder has to furnish latest/valid affidavit on non judicial stamp paper duly attested by th e Executive Magistrate/Notary regarding non- blacklisting/non prosecutio n of the firm as per Performa as per (Annexure-1) Affidavit l/we (Name) Se rvice provider/Partner/Sole proprietor (Strike out which is not applicable) of (firm) do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the individual/firm/co mpany is not black listed/prosecuted by any central/state governments U nion Territories/Departments/Offices/Statutory. (n) Bodies/Autonomous Organizations/Research Institutions/any court of l aw. No part of it is false and nothing has been kept concealed there fr om Place Deponent Date, Not more than one month old from the date of b id. (note: To be furnished on non-judicial stamp paper Rs. 10/- duly attest ed by the Executive magistrate/Notary). (p) Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of After award of contract, Su ccessful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and ha s to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 1

5 days of award of contract. (q) Escalation Matrix For Service support: Bidder/OEM must provide Es calation Matirx of Telephone Numbers for service support. (r) Past Experience of Similar Services: The Bidder must have successf ully executed/ completed at least one single order of 80% of the Estimate d Bid Value or 2 orders each of 50% of the Estimated Bid Value or 3 order s each of 40% of the Estimated Bid Value for similar service (s) in last thre e years to any Central/state Govt Organization/PSU/Public Listed Company . Copies of contracts /work orders and documentary evidence of successfu l execution/completion in support of Past Experience of Similar Service alo ng with names, address and contact details of clients shall be uploaded wi th the bid for verification by the Buyer. (s) The Seller among other requirements shall ensure the following:- (i) The stores are not be allowed to be taken out / bought in without prope r pass/authority and documents from the Commander Coast Guard Distri ct Headquarters No.11. (ii) The intimation is to be made of any trespassing, loss/theft, fire or abno rmal incident to the Commander Coast Guard District Headquarters No.1 1. (iii) To carry out all the instructions given by Commander Coast Guard Dis trict Headquarters No.11. (iv) To check identity of guests/visitors desirous of visiting the offices/staff . (v) That no housekeeping staff consumes liquor or is in intoxicated conditi on whilst on duty. They will have no facilities/amenities that are extended to the Coast Guard personnel and their families and Seller may make their own arrangement for the same at their own cost. 3. Police Verification. At all times, the contractor will be responsible to ensure that the outsourcing of housekeeping staff engaged by hi m are security cleared by Police Station of worker's residential area. Police verifi

cation is to be submitted at least 15 days prior to commencement of the contra ct. The contractor will also ensure that no person employed by him for the servi ces if he has been/ is involved in any activity against the interest of state. 4. Uniform. The Outsourcing of housekeeping Staff deployed by the Con tractor shall be in distinct/neat uniform including shirt/trouser, Cap along with p air of black shoe, with logo of the firm embossed. Samples of the uniform are to be approved by the Seller prior to commencement of the Contract. In order to maintain neat and clean uniforms at all times at least two set of uniforms to be issued to employees per annul. All the employees shall have a dress code and t he summer/winter uniform shall be provided by the contractor. 5. Responsibility of Payment of Wages. The contractor will be sh all make payment to the contract labour employed to their bank accounts on m onthly basis/number of days under the contract and an officer nominated by Dis trict Commander, CGDHQ-11 will ensure the same on or before the 5th of every month. The payment in any case shall not be delayed beyond the 7th of the foll owing month. 6. Registers and other Records to be Maintained. The Registers and R ecords that will be maintained by Contractor are as follows: (i) Service Certificate to be issued to every housekeeping staff on ter mination of employment for any reason. (ii) Form of Register of Wages Cum Muster Roll. The same will be coun tersigned by District Commander, CGDHQ-11 or an officer appointed by hi m on the day the wages is paid in the presence of the representative of th e Principal Employer. (iii) Wage Slip, which will be issued to each worker on the day the wag es is paid in the presence of the representative of the Principal Employer. 7. Warning Clause. In case any complaint received from users, the follo wing penalty will be imposed in addition to deduction of amount equivalent to d eficiency in manpower deployment/material supplied: (a) First Complaint - Verbal Warning. (b) Second & Third Complaint - Written Warning/Show Cause Notice. (c) Fourth & Fifth Complaint - Deduction of 1/4 amount of the

monthly Bill. (d) Sixth Complaint - Issue of show cause notice for ter mination of contract and PBG of the contract will be forfeited. 8. Compliance of Labor Laws. The contractor shall fulfill all obligation s under various labour laws in force regarding deployment of contract workers i respect of the services provided under this contract. 9. Penalty. The contractor will be penalized on following occasions: (a) Outsourcing staff not reporting for duty. Double the amount of pay for absent day will be penalized from the contractor. (b) Any theft or damage to CG assets occurred due to negligence by th e staff, Contractor will be penalized for theft amount and has to pay the a mount within 48 hrs of incident. (c) The contract shall be for a period of one year with effect from the d ate of signing of the contract. The District Commander, CGDHQ-11 shall h owever have the right to terminate the contract after giving one month's notice in writing without assigning any reasons, whatsoever and the decisi on of the District Commander, CGDHQ-11 shall be final in this regard. Pow er in this regard shall vest with the District Commander, CGDHQ-11. (d) The Seller shall maintain the following registers as per the Govt Lab our Act (R&T) 1970:- (i) Register of workmen (ii) Employment cards (iii) Muster roll registers (iv) Register of wages (v) Any other register/records required by the labour commissioner fro m time to time, shall also be maintained by the contractor. (e) Amy damage done to the existing structures caused by the contrac tor's personnel shall be rectified by the contractor at his own risk and cost . Any theft or breakage caused by the contractor's personnel shall be bor ne by the contractor.

(f) The normal duty hours shall be on 08 hourly. (वनोद के वी / Vinod K V) सहायक समादेशक / Asst Commandant ज़ला शासन एव ंकािमक अिधकार District Admin & Pers Officer कृत ेज़ला कमांडर/for District Commander Date : Nov 26 . 3.
